slides.title: Your own on-chain portfolio.
slides.body: A Garden is a smart contract that **you** own. Your crypto lives there, in your wallet, not ours.

Pick an **Index** or tend it yourself.

slides.title: It prunes itself.
slides.body: Connect to an Index and your Garden **rebalances automatically**, trimming what grew too big and topping up what shrank.

slides.quote: Compound, not pump. Boring is a feature.
